    <Description>
Oligonucleotide probes to 191 human microRNA genes and 198 mouse microRNA genes were designed, antisense to the mature sequence as reported in the Sanger microRNA registry (4/1/04). Probes were spotted at 40 uM on Corning GAPS-II slides in 3X SSC, dried, and crosslinked by 600mJ UV. Slides were prehybridized in 3x SSC, 0.1% SDS, 0.2% BSA for 45 minutes, hybridized for 2h at 37C in 400mM Na2HPO4 pH 7.0, 0.8% BSA,
5% SDS, 12% formamide.
    </Description>
